chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who pledges collateral with another man, and it is destroyed or lost, he عليه السلام said: "He may reclaim his money from him."

key_terms.بِمَالِهِ: with his property, meaning his financial due
key_terms.تَوًى: destruction or perishing of the pledged item
key_terms.يَرْجِعُ: he returns with a claim or recovers
key_terms.يَرْهَنُ: he gives something in pledge as collateral

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if pledged collateral is destroyed or lost in a rahn transaction?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning pledged collateral (rahn) when the pledged item is destroyed or lost. It indicates that the owner of the money retains his financial claim against the other party and may recover his due.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4110 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who pledged a security with another man, and the security was destroyed or lost.
Imam (as) said: "He may reclaim his money from him."
